info.title: PactivaSign API
info.description:
Server-to-server API for sending documents for signature and following them to completion.

**Authentication.** OAuth 2.0 client credentials with `private_key_jwt` (RFC 7523) and DPoP-bound tokens (RFC 9449).
Get a token at `POST /api/v1/oauth/token`, then send `Authorization: DPoP <token>` and a fresh `DPoP` proof on every call.
On `401 use_dpop_nonce`, retry once with the `DPoP-Nonce` value from the response. Each operation lists its scopes in `x-oauth-scopes`.

**Responses.** JSON bodies are `{ "success": true, "data": … }`. Errors are `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "requestId", "details" } }`,
except failures in the OAuth layer, which use the RFC 6749 shape `{ "error", "error_description" }`. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

**Pagination.** Lists take `limit` and `cursor` and return `nextCursor`; pass it back as `cursor` until it is null.

**Retries.** `POST /envelopes` accepts an `Idempotency-Key`; reuse it on every retry of the same send. Honour `Retry-After` on 429.
Rate limits are reported in the `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` headers.

**Webhooks.** Subscribe with `/webhook-subscriptions`. Deliveries are signed in `Pactiva-Signature`; verify it over the raw body,
deduplicate on the event `id` and order by `data.version`. Bodies are described by the `WebhookEvent` schema; `x-webhook-events` lists the types.

**Compatibility.** Within `/api/v1` changes are additive: new fields, endpoints, event types and enum values can appear at any time,
so clients must ignore unknown fields and treat unknown enum values as unknown, not as errors. Fields not listed here are not part of the contract.

oauth2-dpop.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials with private_key_jwt (RFC 7523). Tokens are DPoP-bound (RFC 9449): send `Authorization: DPoP <access_token>` together with the `dpop-proof` header. Bearer use is rejected. Swagger UI cannot sign proofs; use the Node.js example in the docs.

scopes.documents:create: Create drafts and upload document files
scopes.documents:read: Read document metadata, fields, layouts and audit trail
scopes.documents:update: Rename documents; edit draft fields, recipients and layouts; retry finalization
scopes.documents:download: Fetch original or signed PDF content
scopes.templates:read: Read templates, their fields and PDF
scopes.templates:update: Rename, archive, restore and edit template fields
scopes.recipients:read: Search past recipients and list recipient roles
scopes.signing:create: Send signing requests and envelopes (never sign as a recipient)
scopes.signing:read: Read signing request and envelope status
scopes.webhooks:manage: Manage webhook subscriptions and read their delivery log

dpop-proof.name: DPoP
dpop-proof.description: DPoP proof JWT (typ dpop+jwt) signed by the key bound to the access token, with htm, htu, iat, unique jti and ath = base64url(SHA-256(access_token)). New proof per request.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifies the request in our logs. Same as `error.requestId`.

RateLimit.description: IETF RateLimit, e.g. `"client";r=598;t=42`: remaining calls and seconds to reset per policy.

summary.description: One readable sentence, e.g. "Jane Customer signed the document".

eventHash.description: SHA-256 of this event chained to the previous one.

documentIds.description: Prepared documents, in order. One or more. Omit when documents[] carries the PDF or template inline.

documents.description: Parts in packet order. Each part is a documentId, a base64 PDF plus fields, or a templateId. One or more.

sequential.description: When true, only signing order 1 is emailed first.

expiresAt.description: When this envelope expires. Omit for no expiry. Must be in the future and at most 365 days away. Applies to the whole packet.

externalId.description: Your own reference, such as a CRM deal ID. Returned on reads and webhooks and usable as a list filter. Not unique.

metadata.description: Up to 20 string values, keys up to 100 characters. Returned on reads and webhooks.

sequential.description: If true, invitations go out in signingOrder sequence.

expiresAt.description: When this document expires. Omit for no expiry. Must be in the future and at most 365 days away.

signers.description: One or more signers. Fields are assigned by templateRoleId when set, otherwise by metadata.recipientEmail. Omit (with ccRecipients) to send to the recipients saved via PUT /documents/:id/recipients, including template role slots and their signing order.

ccRecipients.description: Optional observers copied on send and when signing completes. They do not sign.

createdById.description: User who created it; null when an OAuth client did.

status.description: Latest invitation email status (QUEUED, ACCEPTED, DELIVERED, FAILED); null before one is sent.

value.description: Filled or default value; shape depends on type.

metadata.description: recipientEmail, recipientRole, font and other layout hints.

signerId.description: Optional existing Signer id in this organization. Omit when placing fields with recipientEmail. Swagger’s sample UUID is ignored.

fontFamily.description: Font for text-style fields (NAME, EMAIL, DATE, TEXT, CHECKBOX, RADIO, DROPDOWN), DocuSign names from GET /fonts. The final PDF embeds the same font file. Legacy HELVETICA / TIMES_ROMAN / COURIER are accepted and stored as ARIAL / TIMES_NEW_ROMAN / COURIER_NEW. Stored on metadata.fontFamily.

fontSize.description: Font size in PDF points. Shrinks automatically if the text does not fit the box. Stored on metadata.fontSize.

italic.description: Italic text. Stored on metadata.italic. Defaults to true only when fontFamily is unset.

defaultValue.description: Prefilled value the signer sees and can change: text for NAME, EMAIL, DATE, TEXT, RADIO and DROPDOWN, true for a ticked CHECKBOX. Not allowed on SIGNATURE or INITIAL. null clears it. Stored on metadata.defaultValue.

recipients.description: One empty slot per template role. Fill name and email with PUT /documents/{id}/recipients.

suggestedSequential.description: True when the roles have different signing orders; send with sequential.

email.description: Null in an unfilled template slot.

role.description: SIGNER and CC are built in. CUSTOM requires customRoleId.

templateRoleId.description: Template role this person fills. Send it back when filling a slot created from a template so fields stay linked to them and the imported signing order is kept when signingOrder is omitted.

signingOrder.description: Signing sequence for recipients who sign. Ignored for copy-only recipients.

createdById.description: User who created it; null when an OAuth client did.

deliveries.description: One per signer on the latest signing request.

version.description: Bumped on every change. Webhooks carry it; ignore events older than what you have.

packetDocumentId.description: The combined document the recipients sign.

signingRequest.description: Kept for existing callers. Use status and recipients.

roleName.description: Copy-only template role name on one of the documents.

x.description: PDF points from the left. DocuSign xPosition.

y.description: PDF points from the top. DocuSign yPosition.

width.description: Omit to use the type default (signature 150×40, date 120×18, checkbox 16×16).

roleName.description: Signer role this box belongs to. Matched to signers[].roleName.

defaultValue.description: Prefilled value the signer sees and can change: text for NAME, EMAIL, DATE, TEXT, RADIO and DROPDOWN, true for a ticked CHECKBOX. Not allowed on SIGNATURE or INITIAL. null clears it. Stored on metadata.defaultValue.

documentId.description: A draft document that already has its PDF and fields.

fileBase64.description: PDF bytes, standard base64. Use this instead of documentId to send a file in this call.

templateId.description: Template to copy into this part. Use this instead of documentId or fileBase64.

values.description: Values for template fields, matched by metadata.fieldIdentifier (the DocuSign tab label).

id.description: Use as recipientId on resend and PATCH.

signingOrder.description: Order in a sequential envelope; 1 signs first.

status.description: CREATED means not invited yet (a later signer in a sequential envelope).

roleName.description: Template role name on one of the documents. Required when that document has roles. Matched ignoring case.

signingOrder.description: Omit to keep the role’s signing order. Defaults to 1 when the signer has no role.

fieldIdentifier.description: Label that identifies the template field. This is the DocuSign tab label (data label), stored on the field as metadata.fieldIdentifier.

tabLabel.description: Former name of fieldIdentifier. Still accepted.

value.description: Text for a text field, or true/false for a checkbox.

code.description: Closed list; new codes are added in minor versions, so treat unknown ones as generic errors.

requestId.description: Same as the X-Request-Id response header. Quote it to support.

ErrorCode.description: Closed list; new codes are added in minor versions, so treat unknown ones as generic errors.

client.description: The calling OAuth client; null otherwise.

scopes.description: Scopes this token can use right now.

rateLimits.description: Per-client limits; null for non-OAuth callers.

error.description: `invalid_token`, `invalid_dpop_proof`, `use_dpop_nonce` (retry once with the DPoP-Nonce header), `insufficient_scope` or `temporarily_unavailable`.

error_description.example: The access token is invalid or expired.

RecipientStatus.description: CREATED means not invited yet (a later signer in a sequential envelope).

recipients.description: Full list, in display order. Replaces whatever was saved before.

recipientId.description: Re-invite only this recipient. Omit to re-invite everyone whose turn it is.

customRoleId.description: Optional custom recipient role (GET /recipient-roles). Its action must match this list.

templateRoleId.description: Template role this copy recipient fills. Its action must be copy-only.

signingOrder.description: Signing sequence when sequential is true. Same order = parallel group.

customRoleId.description: Optional custom recipient role (GET /recipient-roles). Its action must match this list.

templateRoleId.description: Template role this signer fills. Fields linked to that role are assigned to them instead of by email.

metadata.description: fieldIdentifier (prefill key on POST /envelopes values), font and layout hints.

name.description: Unique within the template. Matched by roleName on POST /envelopes.

signerId.description: Optional existing Signer id in this organization. Omit when placing fields with recipientEmail. Swagger’s sample UUID is ignored.

fontFamily.description: Font for text-style fields (NAME, EMAIL, DATE, TEXT, CHECKBOX, RADIO, DROPDOWN), DocuSign names from GET /fonts. The final PDF embeds the same font file. Legacy HELVETICA / TIMES_ROMAN / COURIER are accepted and stored as ARIAL / TIMES_NEW_ROMAN / COURIER_NEW. Stored on metadata.fontFamily.

fontSize.description: Font size in PDF points. Shrinks automatically if the text does not fit the box. Stored on metadata.fontSize.

italic.description: Italic text. Stored on metadata.italic. Defaults to true only when fontFamily is unset.

defaultValue.description: Prefilled value the signer sees and can change: text for NAME, EMAIL, DATE, TEXT, RADIO and DROPDOWN, true for a ticked CHECKBOX. Not allowed on SIGNATURE or INITIAL. null clears it. Stored on metadata.defaultValue.

email.description: New address. The old link stops working and an invitation goes to this one.

active.description: false pauses deliveries; true re-enables a disabled subscription.

lastResponseSnippet.description: First bytes of the receiver response.

version.description: Envelope version after this change. Ignore events older than what you have.

status.description: Azure Communication Services delivery status, e.g. Delivered, Failed, Bounced, Suppressed.

id.description: The delivery, queued again with the same event.

active.description: False when paused, or disabled after a 410 or 3 days of failures.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until then, deliveries also carry a signature made with the previous secret.

active.description: False when paused, or disabled after a 410 or 3 days of failures.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until then, deliveries also carry a signature made with the previous secret.

secret.description: Returned only on create and rotate. Store it.
